composites.name: tnf-field-cell
composites.description: One cell in a TNF field: a TNF bolus diffuses in the medium (FVReactionDiffusion), RegionMean reads it at the cell's surface, one-site occupancy (Kd 19 pM) drives Lipniacki 2004 NF-kB's TNF_R and Calzone 2010's TNF node, and NF-kB's nuclear fraction drives Calzone's NF-kB node.

kappa.description: NF-kB node switching rate (1/s): ln 2 / NF-kB's nuclear half-rise (decision 25)

k_time.description: death-machinery clock (Calzone units per s), > 0; 1/120 here, Study 1's fastest clock, so the fate network responds within 1000 s

r_tx.description: transcription-scale steps' ON rate (1/s), from Lipniacki

absorb_death.description: 1: Apoptosis and NonACD stay on once on (death is irreversible; decision 28); 0: Calzone's reversible death nodes. A switch: any nonzero value is absorbing

Kd.description: TNF-TNFR1 dissociation constant (uM): 1.9e-11 M at 37 C, Grell et al. 1998

composites.name: kinetic-boolean
composites.description: One cell: Lipniacki 2004 NF-kB (TelluriumProcess, pre-equilibrated, TNF_R stepped to 1 through parameters_in) -> NF-kB nuclear fraction f (the SBML's own rule) -> Calzone 2010 cell fate (MaBoSSProcess, all 31 nodes, NF-kB gated by Calzone's own logic). The Boolean NF-kB node switches at kappa per second; the death machinery runs on k_time.

kappa.description: NF-kB node switching rate (1/s): ln 2 / NF-kB's nuclear half-rise (decision 25)

r_tx.description: transcription-scale steps' ON rate (1/s), from Lipniacki

absorb_death.description: 1: Apoptosis and NonACD stay on once on (death is irreversible; decision 28); 0: Calzone's reversible death nodes. A switch: any nonzero value is absorbing

anchor_activation.description: 1: NF-kB's activation route (RIP1, RIP1ub, IKK) switches on at r_act per second (decision 30); 0: Calzone's clock, k_time. A switch

r_act.description: activation route's ON rate (1/s), from Lipniacki's IKK_active half-rise
